_meta.policy: Each commit is a genuine change whose diff matches its message. The old runner appended comment stamps to source files and wrote @pytest.mark.skip test stubs; both were removed on 2026-07-14. Weeks 1-7 (docs/api scaffolds, real tests, the suppress_warnings / to_json / clip-warning features) are complete and their real content is already in the repo. When this backlog is exhausted, add more entries with matching scaffolds/ files or let genuine development drive the history — do NOT reintroduce synthetic commits.
